title: Mamata Banerjee’s Delhi arrival fuels buzz over INDIA bloc meet with President
description: TMC chairperson Mamata Banerjee's arrival in Delhi has heightened anticipation for the requested meeting with President Droupadi Murmu. The opposition bloc is awaiting confirmation for a meeting date between October 7 and 9. The delegation has been limited to ten members as requested by the President's Secretariat. CPI(M)'s John Brittas has submitted a petition for constitutional intervention regarding the Election Commission.

title: Centre cites Supreme Court order, seeks to void Jharkhand DGP appointment
description: Supreme Court has agreed to hear the application from the Centre regarding Tadasha Mishra's appointment as Jharkhand DGP. The appointment has been challenged due to its conflict with procedures set in the SC's 2006 Prakash Singh judgement. Moreover, the Centre claimed that prior DGP appointments in Jharkhand were also illegal for similar reasons. Mishra's appointment occurred shortly before her retirement, which raised legal concerns.

title: SC to hear Centre’s plea against Jharkhand DGP appointments
description: A Bench comprising Chief Justice Surya Kant and justices Joymalya Bagchi and V. Mohana was urged by Solicitor General Tushar Mehta that the contempt plea be also listed for hearing

title: Chicago’s vacant 32-acre site gets $127m housing redevelopment plan
description: The Chicago city council has recently granted approval for redevelopment plans at the LeClaire Courts site. The initial phase will feature two six-story buildings containing 183 apartments and a childcare facility, with approximately 90 percent of the units designated for low-income households. Set to begin construction in late 2026, this project aims to breathe new life into the area, fostering community and connectivity where it has long been absent.

title: 'Cash-for transfers' WA chats part of CBI dossier on Mann OSD
description: A set of WhatsApp chats has emerged, alleging monetary transactions involving senior Punjab government officials and DSPs. CBI's dossier includes these chats as they prepare to interrogate CM Bhagwant Mann's OSD Rajbir Singh Ghuman. Allegations suggest that intermediaries received bribes for influencing transfers and policy formulations affecting IAS and IPS officers. Additionally, documents indicate potential irregularities in real estate projects and the Greater Mohali Area Development Authority.

title: Sandra Bullock’s 91-acre California ranch with 1,200 avocado trees sells for $5.6m
description: In 2007, Sandra Bullock acquired a sprawling 91-acre ranch in Valley Center for $2.725 million. After transforming it with extensive renovations and establishing an organic avocado farm, she sold the property for $5.6 million in 2024. Encompassing a beautifully refurbished adobe house, a guest cottage, and facilities for agricultural operations, the ranch stands as a perfect blend of luxury and sustainability for its future owner.

title: Karthik upsets Kamboj; Manish, Vaidehee reach quarters at Fenesta Open
description: The top five players in the women’s singles draw also booked their spots in the quarterfinals. Vaidehee Chaudhari defeated 16-year-old Ahaan Ahaan 6-4, 6-1, while Shruti Ahlawat beat Parthsarthi Mundhe 6-2, 6-2

title: Rohan Bopanna returns to action, will represent Gurgaon Grand Slammers in TPL
description: Argentina's world No. 60 Roman Burruchaga, representing the Kolkata Thunder Blades, will be the highest-ranked singles player in the league

title: Medical trips costliest in both rural & urban areas
description: Health and medical trips incurred the highest expenses in rural and urban areas during a one-year period. The average expenditure for these trips was notably higher in urban than rural areas. Pilgrimage travel accounted for the largest share of trips taken throughout the year. Accommodation and transport were significant expenditures for health and medical trips, underscoring their financial impact.

title: From the brink to a comeback, hope for India’s wildlife
description: The current state of some of India’s endangered species is encouraging, but sustained conservation, science and local action remain essential

title: With PM Modi set to visit Ottawa, India & Canada back CEPA
description: India and Canada are currently engaged in the fifth round of talks for a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement. Both countries aim to sign the CEPA during Prime Minister Modi's anticipated visit to Canada. The visit is tentatively scheduled for December 11-13, just before the G20 summit in Florida. Leaders from both nations envision boosting bilateral trade to CAD 70 billion by 2030.

title: Cornell students stage sit-in to protest university’s handling of alleged 2024 gang rape
description: Some Cornell students have staged a sit-in at a dining hall and vowed not to spend money on campus to protest sexual violence and how the university has handled complaints

title: Assam CM Himanta Sarma says woman sent to Bangladesh safe, son counters CM
description: Mumtaz Begum, a woman expelled to Bangladesh, remains untraceable by her family despite official claims of her safety. Her son, Momruz Ali, is pleading for government assistance to locate her in either country. The Gauhati High Court directed authorities to find Mumtaz and provide interim compensation to her husband. Reports indicate that searches in Bangladesh yielded no results for her whereabouts so far.

title: Evicted Spanish octogenarian Maricarmen Abascal, heart of Spain's housing protests, has died
description: Ms. Abascal had been in hospital since her eviction on September 23 from her home of more than 70 ‌years, when police and social workers removed her by stretcher

title: Loans set to get dearer as RBI hikes repo rate after 44 months
description: The Reserve Bank of India has announced a 25 basis points increase in the repo rate to 5.5%. This decision reflects growing inflation pressures and stronger than anticipated economic growth. The rise in interest rates will lead to higher loan EMIs, impacting consumption during the festive season. Banks are expected to increase fixed deposit rates following this policy change.

title: 'One student, one day': CUET-UG 2027 may get shorter, simpler
description: CUET-UG 2027 may implement notable changes to streamline the examination experience for students. Candidates could see a reduction in the number of subjects from five to four over time. The proposed changes also include shortening the duration of individual papers to enhance efficiency. Subject grouping may allow related papers to be scheduled together for a single-day examination.

title: Anti-CEC protests: Oppn, police face off again; Rahul says won’t stop till Gyanesh quits
description: Opposition members from the INDIA bloc attempted to stage a protest demanding the resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar. They were detained by Delhi Police less than a kilometer from their protest site at Jantar Mantar. Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge organized the lunch gathering, where the protest plan was discussed. Difficulties in moving their buses led to further confrontations with police as they sought to demonstrate.

title: Trump administration plans to charge international students $70,000 for work authorisation
description: Under ‌the proposal, nonimmigrant students with F-1 visas would be required to pay $70,000 to a certified institution for on-the-job training, known as ‌Optional Practical Training (OPT), and $30,000 for any additional work training

description: He asserted that the Union is not opposed to development; however, development that comes at the cost of farmers losing their land, livelihoods, and social security cannot be accepted.

title: 'We'll do it': PM Modi gives slogan for 2047 goals
description: PM Narendra Modi delivered a speech highlighting his 25 years in government and the goal of developed India by 2047. He called upon citizens to commit to this ambitious target and emphasized the power of the people. Modi reiterated the importance of extraordinary goals, linking good governance to societal inclusion. He reflected on his journey from humble beginnings to leadership in the BJP.

He believes this reflects an undervaluation of Indian culinary traditions compared to European cuisine. The restaurant has a significant historical background with notable patrons, including Indian leaders. The Crown Estate maintains its decision is based on structural issues and not culinary bias.

title: Grenade seizure case: Pakistan-based ultra declared ‘proclaimed offender’
description: A special NIA court in Jammu has declared Nazir Hussain a proclaimed offender regarding grenade seizures. Hussain, originally from Hari village, is believed to be hiding in Pakistan currently. The court noted that previous non-bailable arrest warrants could not be executed due to his absence from home. Additionally, multiple attempts to compel Hussain to surrender have been unsuccessful.

title: India’s first high-altitude snow leopard safari flagged off in Ladakh
description: Ladakh has commenced India's first high-altitude wildlife safari that highlights snow leopard trails and community involvement. Vinai Kumar Saxena, the lieutenant governor, emphasized the importance of coexisting wildlife and development. The Snow Leopard and High-Altitude Nature Conservation Society is coordinating this project with local forest departments. The mapped safari routes traverse significant wildlife areas, including Hemis National Park and Changthang.

This case relates to violence during a terrorist's funeral procession in Srinagar, which Shah allegedly incited. The court expressed concern about potential threats to national security and the safety of protected witnesses. Shah argued that the investigation was reopened without justification and emphasized delays in legal actions.

description: Now listed for $180 million, Turkey Track Ranch encompasses 77,721 acres of breathtaking terrain. After rebounding from the Smokehouse Creek Fire, this property has rejuvenated its cattle operations and features nearly 26 miles of scenic Canadian River frontage, ensuring abundant water supply. With a lineage connected to essential battles and over a hundred years of family ownership, this sale is a unique opportunity to own a remarkable piece of history.

title: Oceans connect, not divide nations, PM Modi says, calls for secure maritime order
description: PM Narendra Modi emphasized the importance of maritime connectivity and proposed a ceasefire plan for the Black Sea. His vision promotes cooperation and mutual benefit among nations to ensure maritime security. Chief of Naval Staff Admiral Krishna Swaminathan highlighted the interconnectedness of national security and economic security. He urged for collective action among regions to tackle maritime threats effectively.

description: Photos emailed

title: FBI foils alleged ISIS-linked attack plot at Mall of America by 18-year-old
description: Sheikhdoon Abdullahi Mohamud, an 18-year-old, was arrested for planning an attack on the Mall of America. He agreed to buy an AK-47 and ammunition from an undercover FBI agent posing as an ISIS member. Mohamud expressed intentions to kill non-Muslims during a scheduled Hmong arts celebration. US authorities stated that his radicalization was identified well before his plan could be executed.

title: Indiana Supreme Court fixes land-taking payout at $20,840 in road project
description: Transportation authorities in Indiana sought to acquire a section of Jeremy Willis's land for a project on State Road 11. An appraisal placed the property's value at $20,840, with no objections raised. The Indiana Supreme Court determined that the appraisal was final according to state law. Consequently, the trial court was directed to finalize the judgment and authorize the fund release.

title: Zohran Mamdani faces backlash for calling Israel’s Gaza war ‘ongoing genocide’ on Oct 7 anniversary
‘Nobody can stop Bumrah & Bhuvi’: Ashwin’s bold prediction as pacer makes India return
description: Ravichandran Ashwin asserts that Bhuvneshwar Kumar’s display in New Zealand might have a significant impact on his chances for World Cup selection. Having last participated in an ODI in 2022, Bhuvneshwar is set to make his return to international cricket. His capacity to swing the ball could enhance India's bowling lineup for next year’s championship.

title: ​IndiGo flight hit by lightning, damage found only after landing in Lucknow
description: An IndiGo flight experienced a lightning strike while approaching Lucknow, damaging its nose radome. The aircraft landed safely, with all 110 people onboard unharmed. The severity of the damage became clear only after the flight was parked. Authorities confirmed that the aircraft will undergo a comprehensive inspection and necessary repairs before service. The Directorate General of Civil Aviation has been notified as per standard procedure.

title: ‘You are doing your job’: Detained Rahul Gandhi offers water to police - watch
A lunch, then a march: How Rahul-led opposition once again kept police guessing
description: The episode was the latest example of a 'dhappa' style protest that Rahul Gandhi and the Congress have recently used. The latest episode began after Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge announced an INDIA bloc sit-in at Jantar Mantar following the lunch. "Today, we will hold a sit-in protest at Jantar Mantar. Until our demands are met, we will continue to stage such protests," Kharge announced.

title: Out on bail after rape allegation, Porel named in Bengal squad for Ranji opener
description: Wicketkeeper-batter Abhishek Porel has been included in Bengal's squad for their upcoming Ranji Trophy match. He was previously arrested on allegations of rape but has since been granted bail. The team has named a strong squad with senior pacers Mohammed Shami and Akash Deep included. Bengal's match against Delhi is set to take place in Kalyani to mark the season opener.

title: ‘TV drama cannot alter reality': India slams Pakistan over cross-border terror
Indian students' American dream hits a $70,000 toll
‘Changed Shreyas’ grip & backlift’: How Nayar helped India T20I captain bounce back
description: Facing a troubling drop in performance, with no scores exceeding 30 in his last ten T20I outings, Shreyas Iyer turned to Abhishek Nayar for help. Their two-hour conversation revolved around critical adjustments to Iyer's batting style. The results were evident as Iyer responded with a stellar 102 not out in the first T20I against West Indies, underscoring his tenacity and capacity to rebound from tough situations.

title: Trump’s naked gold statue unveiled at European Parliament, branded ‘orange plague’
Google ordered to halt data center work in 'Texas of Europe; company admits ‘concerns’
description: Google has received an order to halt construction on its data center projects in Muhos and Kajaani. The Finnish Licensing and Supervision Agency has mandated that construction continues only after environmental impact assessments. Google acknowledged the concerns raised and stated that it would comply with the authority's guidance. The company has emphasized its commitment to biodiversity plans, including extensive tree planting.

title: Messi’s former Barca teammate Pedro retires at 39 after glittering 25-trophy career
description: Pedro Rodriguez bids farewell to football after an illustrious 20-year journey, celebrated at clubs like Barcelona and Chelsea, where he amassed numerous trophies. A member of the victorious Spanish team at the 2010 FIFA World Cup and Euro 2012, he leaves behind a legacy of 794 club appearances and 197 goals. His retirement follows closely behind that of Lionel Messi, signaling the closure of a golden chapter in the sport.

title: Tanker attacks in Strait of Hormuz highest in a week since Iran war began: Report
description: Last week, attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz reached a high level of activity. There were at least twelve incidents reported involving various types of vessels. This surge coincides with Gulf producers increasing their oil exports significantly. The International Maritime Organisation also reported nine separate incidents during the same timeframe. Overall, these developments cast doubts on the stability and security of maritime operations in the region.

title: Akhilesh not invited to INDIA bloc lunch? SP chief's 'samosa' response
Kremlin welcomes India’s push for a Ukraine peace settlement
‘He deserves the same’: England legend laments Ronaldo’s finale compared to Messi’s
description: Gary Lineker expressed his sadness over the conclusion of Cristiano Ronaldo's international journey, contrasting it with Lionel Messi's heartfelt farewell with Argentina. While Messi received an emotional send-off, Ronaldo's exit was steeped in controversy. Lineker advocates for a more fitting tribute to Ronaldo's legacy, recognising his significant impact on football.

title: Meet Jameson Mallon-Echols, student who pulled teen from burning car
From 'vote chori' to 'chita andolan': Street protests return with a new playbook
description: From 'vote chori' protests and women’s safety marches to 'Chita Andolan', the streets are getting politically crowded again. But the old politics of protest now comes with a new playbook. Younger voices, looser networks, social media, viral slogans and issue-based mobilisation are changing how protests begin, spread and draw attention.

title: California home hid miniature town and railway in backyard; sold for $415,000
description: A stunning home in East Hemet, California, has recently changed hands, boasting a remarkable model train city as its centerpiece. This three-bedroom, two-bath residence also features a luxurious pool and spa, enhancing outdoor enjoyment. The property's elaborate train setup adds to its allure, capturing the interest of buyers looking for a unique property. The final sale price reflects both its distinctiveness and competitive positioning in the local real estate market.

title: A musician collected 51 rare guitars worth $1.4m, then donated them to students
Delhi building collapse: Pregnant woman, child among 3 killed in Seemapuri; 8 injured
description: In Seemapuri, Delhi, a tragic building collapse resulted in the loss of three lives, including a child, with eight others injured. The incident, which occurred around 3.15 PM, activated swift rescue operations by both locals and authorities. Concerns about the building’s structural stability arose following recent earthquakes in Uttarakhand. Investigations into the cause of the collapse are ongoing, with local traffic also disrupted due to the incident.

title: Priscilla Chan founded a school; 10 years later, Board votes to close it
description: Priscilla Chan's tuition-free private school in California has shut down after receiving over $125 million in funding. The school, which aimed to support low-income children and families, faced challenges leading to its closure. About 540 children were enrolled, and families expressed concern over the abrupt announcement of the closure. The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative pledged $50 million to assist with transition services and education savings accounts.

title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes’ $1.6m philanthropy: How are they helping 20,000 kids?
description: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes have made children a major focus of their charitable work through the 15 and the Mahomies Foundation. Their efforts include a $1.625 million Boys & Girls Clubs commitment, a $1 million inclusive Kansas City playground, literacy programs reaching more than 20,000 students, community grants and food support for families facing hardship.

title: Travis Kelce’s 87 & Running Foundation: Why are Ed and Donna Kelce involved?
description: Travis Kelce’s 87 & Running Foundation has not posted since January 2026. They continue their charitable work through Operation Breakthrough’s Ignition Lab. Donna Kelce met with Ignition Lab students during a Kansas City Chiefs game. Ed Kelce visited first graders at Operation Breakthrough. Travis Kelce’s foundation got its first post after January on Travis’ birthday.
